1.explanation:
1. ComboBox.js is where the ComboBox renders its input, clear-selection element (via ListBox.Selection), and invalid icon (WarningFilled16). It currently reuses the shared ListBox.Selection component, which is intended for the MultiSelect variant, causing the wrong CSS classes and markup to be emitted for a single-select combobox. Adjustments here are needed to render a dedicated combobox-style clear button or to pass a flag to ListBox.Selection so it doesn’t apply multi-select styling.

2. ListBoxSelection.js defines the shared selection/chip component used by ListBox.Selection, applying filter-tag and multi-select classes (`--tag--filter`, `--list-box__selection--multi`). Because ComboBox is using this component unmodified, it inherits the multi-select chip styling. This file needs to be updated to handle a single-select use case (or accept a prop) so that it emits the correct combobox clear button markup and class names, fixing both the visual style and icon positioning.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots show that the single-select ComboBox is incorrectly picking up the “multi-select” chip/tag styling and positioning for its clear-selection icon, and the invalid-state warning icon is not being positioned correctly. In the first image the red invalid border and icon overlap oddly, and in the second the clear-selection “X” appears as a large black block rather than an inline clear button.
